title: Dad of 3 decided to quit his TSA job amid partial shutdown: "My family had to come first"
summary: Robert Echeverria, a father of three, says he felt he had no other choice but to take another job as the latest partial government shutdown leaves TSA officers without a paycheck again. Echeverria is among more than 300 TSA officers who have quit since the shutdown began last month, according to agency statistics. Kris Van Cleave has more.
